metadata.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026. Centerline digitization by OpenRacetrackDB.
notes: The operator separately publishes a combined-circuit map in its public media catalogue. It identifies a northern-straight exit curving south along the western side of the paddock and a western connecting branch between the northern return diagonal and the southern inner U. That map supplies branch identity only and is not georeferenced, digitized or redistributed. The track-page combined graphic duplicates the southern circuit and remains excluded. All coordinates are independently digitized from the pinned September 2026 Copernicus raster, with June native red, green, blue and near-infrared bands corroborating both connectors. The route retains the northern outer loop and inner western U, upper chicane, northeastern hairpin, eastern paddock-side connection, southern eastern return, long southern straight, western southern hairpin and complete inner spiral. It omits the standalone northern middle S and standalone southern outer northern cap, as identified by the combined-course map. The existing independent southern public road snapshot corroborates pavement identity; no source vertices are moved to a supplied timing point or nominal distance. Native resolution is 10 m. Fine corner radii, centerline placement, direction and historical equivalence remain draft. The independent measured distance is preserved. This is a coarse supporting course trace, not a certified timed lap. No supplied boundary coordinates or diagram pixels supply geometry. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 7011.3 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Approximate 3D playback follows a boundary-normal midpoint path inside the unchanged supplemental inner and outer borders. The independently georeferenced 18 September 2026 Sentinel image corroborates this configuration at its native 10 m resolution, including the paved combined-course connector for Apex III; it does not verify fine edge positions or road widths. The original source trace, timing and border coordinates remain unchanged. Curbs are illustrative, raster terrain heights are estimated and banking is unknown.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use midpoints of outward inner-boundary normals intersecting the outer boundary; the source trace is preserved, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
